name: Fish Chowder
summary: Haddock or cod simmered with salt pork, onion and potato, finished with scalded milk.
ingredients: 4 lb haddock or cod, whole or filleted
A 1 1/2 inch cube of fat salt pork, diced

equipment.help: Scalded milk catches at the bottom of the pot if the heat is wrong, and every hob holds a low heat differently.
equipment.label: Hob

steps.title: Look at the fish
steps.body: Use haddock or cod. Keep the head and bones if the fish is whole, because they make the stock.

steps.title: Skin and bone it
steps.body: Cut the fish in 2 inch pieces. Put the head, tail and backbone in a pan with 2 cups cold water.

steps.title: Simmer the bones
steps.body: Bring the trimmings slowly to the boil and let them simmer, then strain and keep the liquid.

steps.title: Slice the onion
steps.body: A thin slice cooks down into the pork fat and all but disappears into the chowder.

steps.title: Try out the pork
steps.body: Cook the diced salt pork in the pot until the fat runs and the scraps are crisp. Lift the scraps out.

steps.title: Cook the onion
steps.body: Cook the onion in the pork fat until it is soft and pale, not brown.

steps.title: Set a gas burner low
steps.body: Gas answers at once, so turn it down the moment the milk goes in.

steps.title: Set an electric hob low and wait
steps.body: The plate keeps giving off heat after you turn it down. Move the pot off for a minute if it runs away.

steps.title: Set induction to a low number
steps.body: Induction holds a steady low heat well, which is exactly what scalded milk wants.

steps.title: Layer the pot
steps.body: Put in the potatoes, then the fish, then the salt and pepper. Pour the strained fish stock over.

steps.title: Simmer until tender
steps.body: Cook gently until the potatoes are soft. Do not stir hard; it breaks the fish up.

steps.title: Add the milk and butter
steps.body: Pour in the scalded milk, add the butter, and heat through without letting it boil.

steps.title: Serve with crackers
steps.body: Scatter the pork scraps over and serve with split crackers.
